reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of all 16 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 3–4 and 40–66, including every model solution, alternative proof, diagram, scale, component allocation and detailed credit note. All 34 question and 34 solution crops visually inspected.
sourceNotes: All sixteen original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 3–4 and 40–66 independently visually inspected. Paper 1 is common with the legacy exam and is already covered by its own review.
All 34 tasks and 300 marks retained. Q5(a), Q6(a) and Q6(c) remain whole at their published scales.
Section 0 uses deduction rules with general guidance on PDF page 53. Sections A/B use exact 2010 Foundation bands with guidance on pages 58–59; only Q8(a)–(d) permit starred minus-one awards.
Original diagrams, worked solutions, alternative answers and full detailed credit notes retained. All contextual tables and dependent sail measurements travel with split tasks.

The summary table (PDF page 59) labels Q8(d) 10C*, but the detailed notes (page 64) explicitly use 10B* with one partial-credit band. This card follows the detailed rule: 0, 6, 9 or 10 marks. The nine-mark allowance is the starred full-credit-minus-one award. Accept consistent answers carried from earlier parts.
No finite optional answer-route pool requires expansion; probability judgments and the justified comparison of mean and median remain complete responses.
